data.name: Nissa
data.gender_notes: Nissa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nissa is derived from the Arabic word 'nisaa' which means women or lady. The name Nissa carries the meaning “Women, Lady” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nissa usually hope their child will grow to embody women, lady and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nissa is a Quranic name, often associated with respect, dignity and power.
data.etymology: Nissa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Women, Lady.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nissa total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نساء
in_arabic.meaning: نساء تعني النساء أو الجنس اللطيف باللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم نساء مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ن-س-ء، ويشير إلى الجنس اللطيف أو النساء بشكل عام. يستخدم هذا الاسم في اللغة العربية للإشارة إلى مجموعة من النساء أو كتعبير عن الجنس المؤنث. نساء هو اسم جمع مؤنث سالم، ويعكس الأهمية والاحترام للمرأة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: نساء
in_urdu.meaning: نساء مطلب ہے خواتین یا نرینہ جنس، اردو میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام نساء عربی جڑ ن-س-ء سے ماخوذ ہے، جو خواتین یا نسائی جنس کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اردو میں خواتین کے گروہ یا نسائی جنس کے تعبیر کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ نساء ایک جمع مؤنث سالم نام ہے، جو اسلامی ثقافت میں خواتین کی اہمیت اور احترام کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: निसा
in_hindi.meaning: निसा का अर्थ है महिलाएं या स्त्री लिंग, हिंदी में
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम निसा अरबी जड़ न-س-ء से लिया गया है, जो महिलाओं या स्त्री लिंग को दर्शाता है। यह नाम हिंदी में महिलाओं के समूह या स्त्री लिंग के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है। निसा एक स्त्रीलिंग संज्ञा है, जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में महिलाओं के महत्व और सम्मान को दर्शाती है।

in_pashto.name: نسا
in_pashto.meaning: نسا معنی دے ښځې یا ښځینه جنس، پښتو کې
in_pashto.long_meaning: د نسا نوم د عربي ريښې ن-س-ء څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې ښځې یا ښځینه جنس ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم پښتو کې د ښځو د ډلې يا ښځینه جنس د تعبير په توګه کارول کيږي. نسا يو جمع مؤنث سا لم نوم دی، کوم چې د افغانستان په اسلامي کلتور کې د ښځو اهميت او احترام ښيي.

in_english.name: Nissa
in_english.meaning: Nissa means women or the feminine gender
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nissa is derived from the Arabic root n-s-ʾ, which refers to women or the feminine gender. Nissa is used to signify a group of women or as an expression of the feminine sex. It reflects the importance and respect for women in Islamic culture, with roots in Arabic linguistic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: In Arabic and Islamic culture, women hold a significant place in society. They are revered and cherished as mothers, wives, and daughters. The term 'nisaa' (women) signifies a representation of the feminine energy and the intricate role they play in various aspects of life. Thus, the name Nissa can be seen as a tribute and a symbolic representation of the strength, beauty, and intrinsic worth of women.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, woman is considered the 'mother of creation' in Islam, as she is the vessel through which new life is brought forth. Nissa, derived from the Arabic word for women, can be seen as a reminder and a reflection of the profound spiritual connection between the feminine principle and the act of creation. The name is a constant reminder of the honor and respect due to women as the embodiment of nurturing, love, and grace.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Women, Lady" symbolizes Nissa is derived from the Arabic word 'nisaa' which means women or lady.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nissa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of women, lady.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Nissa bint Jabshah was the wife of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Nissa carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Nissa was a prominent woman of the Quraysh tribe who accepted Islam and married the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) in Medina.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Nissa remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
